event.title: Liberia to Accept 1,200 US Deportees Under Migration Agreement
event.canonical_title: Liberia to Accept 1,200 US Deportees Under Migration Agreement
event.summary: Liberia has agreed to accept up to 1,200 deportees from the United States, including individuals from Africa, North America, South America, and the Caribbean. The first group of 20 deportees is expected to arrive on Thursday, with the process continuing over the next year.

timeline.title: First Migrants Deported from US Arrive in Liberia Under Humanitarian Agreement
timeline.summary: The first 20 migrants deported from the United States have arrived in Liberia as part of a new agreement allowing the country to accept up to 1,200 foreign nationals over the next year. This deal is described by authorities as 'entirely humanitarian.'
key_facts: First 20 migrants deported from the US arrived in Liberia.
Liberia will accept up to 1,200 foreign nationals deported from the US within a year.
The agreement is characterized as 'entirely humanitarian.'

timeline.title: EU Nations Plan 'Return Hubs' for Rejected Migrants
timeline.summary: Five European Union countries are negotiating with an unnamed non-EU country to establish 'return hubs' for migrants whose asylum applications have been denied. The initiative aims for a targeted start date of January 1, 2027, according to a Danish minister.
key_facts: Five EU countries are seeking a deal for return hubs.
The hubs will host migrants with rejected asylum applications.
Targeted start date for the initiative is January 1, 2027.
